prompt.agentInstruction:
The user is on the “{{page}}” page and wants help configuring it.
Use Vetta Desktop app capabilities to inspect and change settings (do not ask the user to edit config files).
If the request is clear, inspect current state then act; if unclear, ask one focused clarifying question.
Write operations will prompt for confirmation in the app; do not auto-retry after a rejection.
The user's specific request is in this turn's user message body.

kbHowItWorksDesc: Automatically organizes your knowledge base materials into wiki notes for AI access. The AI references these materials when chatting.
kbEnableDesc: When disabled, AI stops using the knowledge base and stops processing materials.
kbIntervalDesc: How often to automatically process new materials. Select "Never" to only process on demand.
kbParallelDesc: Number of concurrent AI sessions for processing. Higher is faster but uses more model quota.
kbNoModelSelected: No model selected. Auto-processing will not run.
kbProcessNowDesc: Start processing all new materials immediately. Model selection is required.
kbRetryFailedDesc: Files that fail processing repeatedly are paused from auto-retry (to avoid spinning). Click here after fixing them, or to try again: it clears the pause and reprocesses immediately.
kbRecordsDesc: View what AI processed each time.
kbClearWikiDesc: Delete all wiki notes and processing records (original files are preserved). Next processing will re-process everything.
kbClearWikiMsg: This will delete all wiki notes and processing records. Original materials are preserved. Next processing will re-process everything, which may use more model quota. Continue?
kbCleared: Wiki cleared. Next processing will re-process everything.
kbProcessing: Processing started. Check records for progress.
kbNoChanges: No file changes detected, no processing needed.

kbHiwSubtitle: Three simple steps to see how your materials become knowledge the AI can use, and where tokens are spent.
kbHiwStep1Desc: Drag files and documents into the knowledge base and organize them by folder, just like managing a directory.
kbHiwStep2Desc: In the background, the AI reads each document and distills it into searchable notes. The more and larger the materials, the more tokens this step consumes.
kbHiwStep3Desc: When you ask a question, the AI first finds relevant content in these notes, then reads the matched snippets into the conversation, which also consumes extra tokens.
kbHiwWhyDesc: Both organizing materials and answering questions require the AI to read through content. The more materials and the more frequent the questions, the higher the consumption. If you don't need it for now, lower the processing frequency or turn off the knowledge base in Settings · Knowledge Base.
kbPageSubtitle: Manage materials with a familiar file and folder structure; new content is organized automatically.
kbPageTokenNote: Using the knowledge base consumes a lot of tokens.

awakeningSpark.name: Spark of Awakening
awakeningSpark.meaning: Commemorates the intellectual awakening of the New Culture and May Fourth movements, honoring those who spread Marxism and symbolizing the spark that broke old thinking and inspired national renewal.

redBoatVoyage.name: Red Boat Sets Sail
redBoatVoyage.meaning: Traces the Red Boat spirit and the founding of the Party, symbolizing the courage to lead, loyalty to the people, and readiness to shoulder a historic mission.

jinggangFire.name: Jinggang Spark
jinggangFire.meaning: Carries forward the spirit of August First, Jinggangshan, and the Soviet areas, symbolizing roots among the people, hard struggle, and revolutionary resolve.

longMarch.name: The Long March
longMarch.meaning: Honors the Long March spirit and the heroic defense of conviction in desperate conditions, symbolizing courage, unity, and unwavering faith.

yananBeacon.name: Yan'an Beacon
yananBeacon.meaning: Upholds the Yan'an spirit and the wartime pursuit of truth and people-centered culture, symbolizing realism, service to the people, and self-reliance.

governanceTest.name: The Governing Test
governanceTest.meaning: Recalls the Xibaipo spirit and the call to remain vigilant and modest, symbolizing clear-minded governance, humility, and service to the people.

constructionGlory.name: Blueprint of Construction
constructionGlory.meaning: Honors the builders of socialist development and their spirit of self-reliance, dedication to the nation, and achievement through practical work.

reformTide.name: Tide of Reform
reformTide.meaning: Celebrates the pioneering course of reform and opening up, symbolizing the courage to experiment, openness, inclusion, and determined innovation.

rejuvenationEpic.name: Epic of Rejuvenation
rejuvenationEpic.meaning: Builds on cultural confidence and red heritage while looking toward modernization and national rejuvenation, symbolizing principled innovation and purposeful action.

mortalWarrior.name: Mortal Warrior
mortalWarrior.meaning: A secular martial stage before drawing spiritual energy into the body. There is no orthodox cultivation base yet, and the body remains close to ordinary mortals.

qiRefiningRealm.name: Qi Refining
qiRefiningRealm.meaning: The initial entry realm of cultivation, divided into thirteen layers. Cultivators absorb worldly spiritual energy into magic power, with fragile foundations and mortal-like longevity.

foundationBuildingRealm.name: Foundation Building
foundationBuildingRealm.meaning: The cultivation foundation is stabilized and scattered power becomes condensed. Cultivators can fly on artifacts, cast spells, practice fasting, and gain a longer lifespan.

goldenCoreRealm.name: Golden Core
goldenCoreRealm.meaning: Magic power condenses into a golden core, strengthening divine sense, body, and combat ability. A personal bonded treasure can be refined at this stable stage.

nascentSoulRealm.name: Nascent Soul
nascentSoulRealm.meaning: The golden core breaks and gives birth to a nascent soul, allowing the spirit to persist independently. Even with the body destroyed, rebirth remains possible.

spiritTransformationRealm.name: Spirit Transformation
spiritTransformationRealm.meaning: Cultivation breaks personal limits and can sense and borrow worldly vital energy. It is the human realm's peak and qualifies one for ascension.

voidRefiningRealm.name: Void Refining
voidRefiningRealm.meaning: The starting point of higher cultivation, where the nascent soul and primordial spirit transform deeply. Rule manipulation, divine abilities, and lifespan rise sharply.

bodyFusionRealm.name: Body Fusion
bodyFusionRealm.meaning: Body, primordial spirit, and magic power merge into one complete foundation. Strength far surpasses Void Refining cultivators and can guard a region.

greatAscensionRealm.name: Great Ascension
greatAscensionRealm.meaning: The peak realm of lower-world cultivation. Body, divine sense, and law comprehension reach worldly limits, forming the foundation to challenge the immortal world.

tribulationTranscendRealm.name: Tribulation Transcendence
tribulationTranscendRealm.meaning: A transitional ascension trial where cultivators endure heavenly thunder to temper body and soul. Passing it breaks lower-world limits and enters immortal cultivation.

trueImmortalRealm.name: True Immortal
trueImmortalRealm.meaning: The orthodox initial immortal realm, where mortal magic power is fully shed and pure immortal essence is refined, granting an immortal status and long lifespan.

goldenImmortalRealm.name: Golden Immortal
goldenImmortalRealm.meaning: An advanced immortal rank beyond True Immortal, requiring opened immortal apertures and source-law comprehension. Three decline tribulations temper immortal body and soul.

taiyiJadeImmortalRealm.name: Taiyi Jade Immortal
taiyiJadeImmortalRealm.meaning: A top immortal realm beyond Golden Immortal constraints, passing dual decline tribulations. Law comprehension is profound enough to govern an immortal domain.

daluoGoldenImmortalRealm.name: Daluo Golden Immortal
daluoGoldenImmortalRealm.meaning: A high peak immortal realm with deep mastery of great dao laws, able to influence cosmic order. It requires severing the three corpse obsessions.

daoAncestorRealm.name: Dao Ancestor
daoAncestorRealm.meaning: The ultimate cultivation realm, severing all three corpse obsessions and fully perceiving the dao's source. It commands complete heavenly laws and stands at the summit.
